peter.name: Peter Parker
peter.personality: Kind, stubborn, academically brilliant, quietly insecure.
peter.bio: Son of Nexa's former No. 1 and No. 2 heroes, yet born without a power. Top of his class in every written exam and last in every power trial. Bullied, underestimated — and about to receive the Transcendent System.

mother.name: Elena Parker
mother.personality: Warm, protective, sharp-eyed. Hides her worry behind jokes.
mother.bio: Once the second-strongest hero on Nexa. After her husband vanished fighting Zero she was given government housing 'for her service' — a polite cage. She raises Peter alone and senses far more than she says.

father.name: Richard Parker
father.personality: Gentle giant. Laughed easily, fought like a storm.
father.bio: Nexa's greatest hero, whose raw physical power was said to end any fight in a single blow, and whose body moved on Ultra Instinct. He defeated Zero at the cost of his apparent death — but Zero absorbed his power and sealed him on a distant planet. Peter does not know.

john.name: John Reyes
john.personality: Cheerful, loyal, talks too fast when nervous. Braver than he thinks.
john.bio: A new student with a rare Copy ability: he can mimic another person's power for a short time. Bruce made him a target on his first day — until Peter stepped in.

bruce.name: Bruce Kaizer
bruce.role: Strongest student • Leader of Frostfire Dominion
bruce.personality: Arrogant, disciplined, ruthless in a fight. Craves his father's approval.
bruce.bio: The academy's strongest student. Teleportation, fire and ice, and martial arts drilled into him by a merciless master (trained in Garou's style). His father has quiet connections to Zero's regime.

zero.name: Zero
zero.bio: An overwhelmingly powerful being connected to the Dragon Ball universe. He fought Nexa's No. 1 hero, absorbed his power, and conquered the planet. His influence reaches across the multiverse.

professor.name: Professor Hale
professor.personality: Strict but fair. Notices potential others miss.
professor.bio: Peter's homeroom teacher and head of the academy's power competitions. One of the few adults who treats Peter with respect.

nurse.name: Nurse Aiko
nurse.bio: The nurse who looks after Peter whenever he ends up in hospital — which happens more than she'd like.

coach_varga.name: Coach Varga
coach_varga.bio: Runs the public Training Centre. Doesn't care if you have a power — only if you show up.

captain_solaris.name: Captain Solaris
captain_solaris.bio: A hero who serves under Zero's regime. Respected Peter's parents — and feels guilty about it.

lantern_kyra.name: Lantern Kyra
lantern_kyra.bio: The Green Lantern who found Peter half-dead in a crater on Oa and decided he was worth saving — and training.

guardian_oren.name: Guardian Oren
guardian_oren.bio: An elder of Oa who recognises in Peter something the universe has not seen in a very long time.

hollow_master.name: The Hollow Master
hollow_master.bio: A hero from an anime-style world who trained so hard he can end any fight with one punch. Teaches Peter that strength is built one ordinary day at a time.

crimson_runner.name: The Crimson Runner
crimson_runner.bio: The fastest being in a DC-style universe. Teaches Peter to move faster than thought.

sanctum_sorcerer.name: The Sanctum Sorcerer
sanctum_sorcerer.personality: Precise, proud, secretly fond of students.
sanctum_sorcerer.bio: Master of the mystic arts in a Marvel-style universe. Teaches Peter to fold space and step anywhere.

shadow_echo.name: Echo of the Shadow Monarch
shadow_echo.bio: The lingering will of a monarch who commanded the dead. It tests whether Peter can carry the power to say: ARISE.

rina.name: Rina Vale
rina.bio: Gravity manipulator and Bruce's right hand.

dex.name: Dex Okoro
dex.bio: His skin hardens into steel. Bruce's favourite attack dog.

gorran.name: Gorran Steel
gorran.bio: Super strength and a short temper. Respects only those who can take a hit.

brick.name: Brick
brick.personality: Simple, loyal, surprisingly kind to animals.
brick.bio: Density control. Hits like a truck.

selene.name: Selene Noir
selene.bio: Illusion caster. Nobody is sure what she really looks like.

kade.name: Kade Volt
kade.bio: Lightning speed. Has never lost a race.

zip.name: Zip
zip.bio: Wind manipulation. Knows every rumour in school.

frostfire_dominion.name: Frostfire Dominion
frostfire_dominion.symbol: A flame and a snowflake split down the middle
frostfire_dominion.abilities: Teleportation, fire & ice, gravity, steel skin
frostfire_dominion.reputation: The strongest crew. Teachers look the other way.
frostfire_dominion.desc: Bruce's crew rules the academy through fear.
frostfire_dominion.secret: Bruce's father reports student power levels to Zero's regime.

iron_fang.name: Iron Fang
iron_fang.reputation: Brutal enforcers who settle everything with fists.
iron_fang.desc: Strength is the only law for Iron Fang.
iron_fang.secret: Gorran secretly sends money to a powerless family in the labour district.

phantom_veil.name: Phantom Veil
phantom_veil.reputation: Tricksters. You never know if they're really there.
phantom_veil.desc: Phantom Veil collects secrets like trophies.
phantom_veil.secret: Selene's illusions are hiding a serious injury.

storm_hounds.name: Storm Hounds
storm_hounds.desc: The Storm Hounds live for races and rankings.
storm_hounds.secret: Kade's speed burns his own body — he can't keep it up for long.
